input.issue: BT-0051 is a duplicate of BT-0050: the same Reece Plumbing Supply invoice 88412 for $1,848.00 was entered twice, and only BT-0050 is on the bank statement.
input.proposed_fix: Delete (void) BT-0051. Keep BT-0050, which is reconciled to SL-0050. This removes a duplicate $1,680.00 from Materials (310) and a duplicate $168.00 GST credit.
input.evidence: BT-0051: Contact Reece Plumbing Supply, Date 2026-08-12, Reference "88412", Total 1848.00 (LineAmount 1680.00, TaxAmount 168.00, account 310, "Materials, J-121"), IsReconciled false. BT-0050: Contact Reece Plumbing Supply, Date 2026-08-11, Reference "INV 88412", Total 1848.00 (LineAmount 1680.00, TaxAmount 168.00, account 310, "Materials, job J-121"), IsReconciled true, matched to SL-0050 (2026-08-11, REECE PLUMBING SUPPLY, -1848.00). No statement line is matched to BT-0051.

input.issue: A laptop costing $2,635.45 ex GST is above the $1,000 capitalise threshold and lasts more than a year, but it was expensed to Repairs and Maintenance.
input.proposed_fix: Recode the line from 473 Repairs and Maintenance to 720 Computer Equipment (fixed asset) at $2,635.45 ex GST, and add it to the fixed asset register for depreciation. The tax treatment is for the GST reviewer to check.
input.evidence: BT-0046, 2026-08-16, Contact JB Hi-Fi Business (default account 720), Description "Laptop for estimator", AccountCode 473, TaxType INPUT, LineAmount 2635.45, TaxAmount 263.55, Total 2899.00. Organisation Policies.CapitaliseThreshold 1000.0.

input.issue: A joinery install charge from a subcontractor was coded to Materials instead of Subcontractors, which distorts job costing for J-118.
input.proposed_fix: Recode the line from 310 Materials to 315 Subcontractors at $5,800.00 ex GST (Total $6,380.00), keeping job J-118. If the invoice shows a separate materials component, split that part to 310.
input.evidence: BT-0047, 2026-08-22, Contact Pinewood Joinery (default account 315; its other payments BT-0030, BT-0031 and BT-0033 are progress claims coded 315), Description "Joinery install, job J-118", AccountCode 310, TaxType INPUT, LineAmount 5800.00, TaxAmount 580.00, Total 6380.00.

input.issue: BT-0052 totals $1,254.00, but the bank statement line it is matched to (SL-0051) shows $1,524.00 paid. The $270.00 gap looks like transposed digits.
input.proposed_fix: Check the Coastal Electrical Contractors tax invoice for the J-124 progress claim. If the invoice is $1,524.00 (the amount that left the bank), correct BT-0052 to Total 1524.00: LineAmount 1385.45, TaxAmount 138.55 (1524.00 / 11), account 315. If the invoice really is $1,254.00, the extra $270.00 is an overpayment. Ask the supplier for a credit or refund and record the $270.00 as a receivable from them.
input.evidence: SL-0051: Date 2026-08-24, Payee COASTAL ELECTRICAL CON, Amount -1524.00, MatchedTransactionID BT-0052. BT-0052: Contact Coastal Electrical Contractors, Date 2026-08-24, "Progress claim, job J-124", account 315, TaxType INPUT, LineAmount 1140.00, TaxAmount 114.00, Total 1254.00, IsReconciled true. The difference is 270.00, which divides by 9, the usual sign of a transposition (1524 vs 1254).

input.issue: A Woolworths grocery purchase on the company account was coded to Entertainment and looks like private spending.
input.proposed_fix: Ask the client whether this had a business purpose. If it was private, recode the full $214.35 to 880 Owner A Drawings as BAS Excluded with no GST. The GST reversal is a separate GST finding.
input.evidence: BT-0048, 2026-08-23, Contact Woolworths, Description "Groceries", AccountCode 420 Entertainment, TaxType INPUT, LineAmount 194.86, TaxAmount 19.49, Total 214.35.

input.issue: The $8,420.00 ATO payment on 28 Aug 2026 (SL-0052) has no Xero transaction, so it is missing from the books.
input.proposed_fix: This is most likely a payment of a prior-period BAS/IAS liability (GST and PAYG withholding) to the ATO integrated client account. Once confirmed, record a spend money transaction of $8,420.00 to ATO, dated 2026-08-28. Code it against the GST and PAYG Withholding liability accounts (or an ATO ICA clearing account) with TaxType BAS Excluded, then reconcile it to SL-0052. To confirm, ask the client for the ATO integrated client account statement and the lodged BAS/IAS showing $8,420.00 payable, and check whether it includes any GIC or penalties, which would go to an expense account.
input.evidence: SL-0052: Date 2026-08-28, Payee ATO PAYMENT, Amount -8420.00, MatchedTransactionID null. No bank transaction for ATO appears in the list of 52 transactions (BT-0001 to BT-0052).

input.issue: A 12-month insurance premium (to 31 Jul 2027) was expensed in full to Insurance in August instead of going to Prepayments and being released monthly.
input.proposed_fix: Recode the $4,800.00 ex GST to 620 Prepayments and keep the $480.00 GST credit. Release $400.00 a month ($4,800.00 / 12) to 433 Insurance, starting August 2026. That leaves $400.00 in Insurance for August and $4,400.00 in Prepayments at 31 Aug 2026.
input.evidence: BT-0049, 2026-08-02, Contact QBE Insurance, Description "Contract works insurance, 12 months to 31 Jul 2027", AccountCode 433, TaxType INPUT, LineAmount 4800.00, TaxAmount 480.00, Total 5280.00. Period 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31; CapitaliseThreshold 1000.0.

input.issue: A GST credit of $360.00 was claimed on a payment to Ridge Tiling, a sole trader who is not registered for GST.
input.proposed_fix: Change TaxType from INPUT to GST free (no credit): LineAmount 3,960.00, TaxAmount 0.00. The GST credit claimed drops by $360.00. Keep account 315.
input.evidence: BT-0043, 2026-08-26, Contact 'Ridge Tiling (sole trader)', 'Tiling, job J-121', AccountCode 315, TaxType INPUT, LineAmount 3600.00, TaxAmount 360.00, Total 3960.00. Contact C006 IsGSTRegistered false (ABN 71 824 330 016).

input.issue: Casual wages were coded INPUT and claimed a $300.00 GST credit, but wages are BAS Excluded.
input.proposed_fix: Change TaxType to BASEXCLUDED: LineAmount 3,300.00, TaxAmount 0.00 on account 477. The GST credit claimed drops by $300.00.
input.evidence: BT-0044, 2026-08-17, Contact 'Payroll Clearing', 'Weekly wages (casual)', AccountCode 477 (Wages and Salaries, default BASEXCLUDED), TaxType INPUT, LineAmount 3000.00, TaxAmount 300.00, Total 3300.00. Contact C020 IsGSTRegistered false. The other wage runs (BT-0001 to BT-0005) are BASEXCLUDED.

input.issue: GST was worked out as 10% of the total ($217.80) instead of 1/11 of the total ($198.00), so the credit is overstated by $19.80.
input.proposed_fix: Correct TaxAmount to 198.00 (2,178.00 / 11) and LineAmount to 1,980.00. The Total stays at 2,178.00.
input.evidence: BT-0045, 2026-08-09, Contact 'Laminex Direct', 'Benchtop laminate, job J-124', AccountCode 310, TaxType INPUT, LineAmount 1960.20, TaxAmount 217.80, Total 2178.00. 2178.00 / 11 = 198.00; 2178.00 x 10% = 217.80.

input.issue: A merchant facility fee coded to Bank Fees claimed a $5.90 GST credit, but under firm policy bank fees are input taxed and get no GST credit.
input.proposed_fix: Change TaxType from INPUT to the account default EXEMPTEXPENSES (the same as the BT-0041 account keeping fee): LineAmount 64.90, TaxAmount 0.00. The GST credit drops by $5.90. Client question: does the CBA merchant statement show GST on this fee? If it is a valid tax invoice with GST, the reviewer may keep the credit.
input.evidence: BT-0042, 2026-08-31, Contact 'Commonwealth Bank', 'Merchant facility fee', AccountCode 404 (Bank Fees, default EXEMPTEXPENSES), TaxType INPUT, LineAmount 59.00, TaxAmount 5.90, Total 64.90. SKILL.md GST rule: 'Bank fees are input taxed: no GST credit.'

input.issue: A $19.49 GST credit was claimed on Woolworths groceries, which look like private spending with no business purpose.
input.proposed_fix: Reverse the credit by setting TaxType to BASEXCLUDED with LineAmount 214.35 and TaxAmount 0.00. If confirmed private, recode to Owner A Drawings (880); that recode belongs to the coding reviewer. Client question: were these groceries for a business purpose (for example, a job site or staff amenities)?
input.evidence: BT-0048, 2026-08-23, Contact 'Woolworths', 'Groceries', AccountCode 420 (Entertainment), TaxType INPUT, LineAmount 194.86, TaxAmount 19.49, Total 214.35.
